snippet.title: Ember Seeker Trailer
snippet.description:
Ember Seeker is releasing June 15th 2026!🔥
Wishlist the game on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4160880/Ember_Seeker/

Ember Seeker is a Dark Fantasy themed walking simulator / exploration game that I've been developing as a personal hobby project for a while now. I'm really grateful for all the positive feedback that the game has received so far even though it's the first videogame I've ever made. The game is going to cost around $7.99 on release. Some of the UI elements may still change and other small changes can still occur as I do some final polishes before release.



#darkfantasy #indiegame #retrogames #atmosphere
